# Jominia syntax exploration test corpus
#
# This file is derived from syntax-exploration.md.
#
# Goals:
# - Exercise the generic Jomini lexer/parser across the full known syntax corpus.
# - Preserve valid examples from the exploration document.
# - Include deliberately malformed examples where parser recovery is useful.
# - Keep semantic validity separate from generic syntactic validity.
#
# Sections marked BROKEN contain intentionally malformed syntax.

# ============================================================================
# Scalars
# ============================================================================

aaa = foo
bbb = -1
ccc = 1.000
ddd = yes
eee = no
fff = "foo"
ggg = 1821.1.1

-1 = aaa
"1821.1.1" = bbb

@my_var = "ccc"

# Multiple binary statements on one line.
a = 1 b = 2 c = 3

# Escaped quotes and backslashes.
hhh = "a\"b"
iii = "\\"
mmm = "\\\""

# Multiline quoted scalar.
ooo = "hello
     world"

# Imperator-style escape-code-looking contents.
nnn = "ab <0x15>D ( ID: 691 )<0x15>!"

# Non-alphanumeric identifiers.
flavor_tur.8 = yes
dashed-identifier = yes
province_id = event_target:agenda_province
@planet_standard_scale = 11

# Very large integer that must not be lossily coerced to float.
identity = 18446744073709547616

# Quoted and unquoted values are syntactically distinct.
unit_type_quoted = "western"
unit_type_unquoted = western

# BROKEN: duplicate operator.
broken_scalar_1 = = foo

# BROKEN: missing RHS.
broken_scalar_2 =

# BROKEN: operator with no LHS.
= broken_scalar_3




# ============================================================================
# Comments and trivia
# ============================================================================

my_obj = # this is going to be great
{ # my_key = prev_value
    my_key = value # better_value
    a = "not # a comment"
} # the end

# Comment between operator and RHS.
timezone = #boop
PST

# Dense boundary-free input.
a_dense = { b = "1" c = d } foo_dense = bar # good

# Even denser boundary-free input.
a_no_space={b="1"c=d}foo_no_space=bar#good


# ============================================================================
# Blocks / positional values / binary statements
# ============================================================================

flags = {
    schools_initiated = 1444.11.11
    mol_polish_march = 1444.12.4
}

players_countries = {
    "Player"
    "ENG"
}

campaign_stats = {
    {
        id = 0
        comparison = 1
        key = "game_country"
        selector = "ENG"
        localization = "England"
    }
    {
        id = 1
        comparison = 2
        key = "longest_reign"
        localization = "Henry VI"
    }
}

# Shorthand block without operator.
foo {
    bar = qux
}

# Empty block.
discovered_by = {}

# Empty blocks mixed with a dated keyed block.
history = {
    {}
    {}
    1629.11.10 = {
        core = AAA
    }
}

# Mixed keyed and positional block.
brittany_area = { #5
    color = { 118 99 151 }
    169 170 171 172 4384
}

# Positional value followed by binary statements.
levels = {
    10
    0 = 2
    1 = 2
}

# Alternating positional values and keyed block statements.
on_actions = {
    faith_holy_order_land_acquisition_pulse
    delay = {
        days = { 5 10 }
    }

    faith_heresy_events_pulse
    delay = {
        days = { 15 20 }
    }

    faith_fervor_events_pulse
}

# Stellaris bare value.
has_overlord_dlc = {
    optimize_memory
    host_has_dlc = "Overlord"
}

# BROKEN: extra operator before block.
broken_block_1 = {
    type add_wargoal_panel = default_block_window = {}
}

# BROKEN: doubled operator.
broken_block_2 = = {}

# BROKEN: missing closing brace.
broken_block_3 = {
    foo = bar

# BROKEN: stray closing brace.
}
broken_after_stray_brace = yes


# ============================================================================
# Operators
# ============================================================================

intrigue >= high_skill_rating
age > 16
count < 2
scope:attacker.primary_title.tier <= tier_county
operator_a != operator_b
start_date == 1066.9.15
c:RUS ?= this

# BROKEN: split operator.
broken_operator_1 > = 16

# BROKEN: repeated operator.
broken_operator_2 != = this


# ============================================================================
# Tagged / externally prefixed blocks
# ============================================================================

color_rgb = rgb { 100 200 150 }
color_hsv = hsv { 0.43 0.86 0.61 }
color_hsv360 = hsv360 { 25 75 63 }
color_hex = hex { aabbccdd }
mild_winter = LIST { 3700 3701 }

# Same syntax with no whitespace before block.
color_rgb_dense = rgb{ 100 200 150 }
color_hsv360_dense = hsv360{ 25 75 63 }

# BROKEN: second operator in a block header.
broken_tagged = rgb = { 100 200 150 }


# ============================================================================
# Unmarked / unbraced RHS value lists
# ============================================================================

simple_cross_flag = {
    pattern = list "christian_emblems_list"
    color1 = list "normal_colors"
}

# More obvious same-line multi-value RHS.
governor = 1 "Gavin Newsom"

# One-value binary statement followed by another binary statement on same line.
foo_sequence = red bar_sequence = blue

# BROKEN semantically for many contexts, but syntactically useful:
# parser should still preserve this as a multi-value RHS.
syntactically_multi_value = one two three four


# ============================================================================
# CK3 scripted effects / parameter-like identifiers
# ============================================================================

give_gold = {
    $GIVER$ = {
        save_scope_as = giver
    }

    $TAKER$ = {
        save_scope_as = taker
    }

    save_scope_value_as = {
        name = gold_amount
        value = $VALUE$
    }

    scope:giver = {
        remove_short_term_gold = scope:gold_amount

        scope:taker = {
            add_gold = scope:gold_amount
        }
    }

    clear_saved_scope = giver
    clear_saved_scope = taker
}


# ============================================================================
# Vic3 scripted parameters
# ============================================================================

transfer_state = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = $GIVER$
            exists = $TAKER$
            $TAKER$ != $GIVER$

            $STATE$ = {
                any_scope_state = {
                    $GIVER$ = owner
                }
            }
        }

        $STATE$ = {
            every_scope_state = {
                limit = {
                    owner = $GIVER$
                }

                set_state_owner = $TAKER$
            }
        }
    }
}

transfer_state = {
    STATE = s:STATE_MONTENEGRO
    GIVER = c:TUR
    TAKER = root
}


# ============================================================================
# Semicolons
# ============================================================================

textureFile3 = "gfx//mapitems//trade_terrain.dds";

# Multiple statements with semicolons.
semi_a = foo;
semi_b = "bar";
semi_c = { 1 2 3 };


# ============================================================================
# Vic3 GUI macro definitions
# ============================================================================

macro = {
    description = "Add a loc key with a trailing newline if a condition is satisfied"
    definition = "MakeLineIf(Condition, LocKey)"
    replace_with = "ConcatIfNeitherEmpty(AddLocalizationIf(Condition, LocKey), Localize( 'NEWLINE' ))"
}


# ============================================================================
# Bracket / parenthesis groups
#
# These remain opaque for now. They are included so the current parser can
# prove losslessness and nested delimiter handling without implementing the
# later expression grammar.
# ============================================================================

[MakeLineIf( IsZero(State.GetTradeCapacity), 'NO_WORLD_MARKET_ACCESS_DUE_TO_NO_TRADE_CAPACITY')]

[ConcatIfNeitherEmpty(AddLocalizationIf( IsZero(State.GetTradeCapacity), 'NO_WORLD_MARKET_ACCESS_DUE_TO_NO_TRADE_CAPACITY'), Localize( 'NEWLINE' ))]

# Nested calls / parentheses.
[Outer(Inner(One), Another(Two, Three))]


# ============================================================================
# @ values / interpolated-expression forms
#
# @[ ... ] expression syntax is intentionally NOT implemented yet.
# These cases should remain lossless and are useful for observing current CST
# behavior before the later expression lexer/parser pass.
# ============================================================================

@pi = 3.1416
@third = @[1/3]
@sub_YUC_hoist_scale = @[third*2]
@canton_scale_cross_x = @[ ( 333 / 768 ) + 0.001 ]
@birthrate_at_growth_max = @[(pop_growth_max_sol-pop_growth_transition_sol)*((min_birthrate-birthrate_at_transition)/(pop_growth_stable_sol-pop_growth_transition_sol))+birthrate_at_transition]
@this_is_you = "this_is_you.dds"
@default_window_file = "gui/notifications/jomini_message.gui"
@default_window_name = "jomini_message"
@tex_star_position = @sixth

position_x = @[1-leo_x]




# ============================================================================
# Vic3 GUI block headers
# ============================================================================

types wargoal_types
{
    type add_wargoal_panel = default_block_window {
        name = "add_wargoal_panel"
        datacontext = "[AddWarGoalPanel.AccessDiplomaticPlay]"

        blockoverride "window_header_name" {
            text = "ADD_WARGOAL_HEADER"
        }

        blockoverride "entire_back_button" {
            back_button_large = {
                position = { 8 30 }
                onclick = "[AddWarGoalPanel.ClearSelectedWarGoalType]"
                input_action = "back"
                visible = "[AddWarGoalPanel.HasSelectedWarGoalType]"
            }

            back_button_large = {
                position = { 8 30 }
                onclick = "[InformationPanelBar.OpenPreviousPanel]"
                input_action = "back"
                visible = "[Not(AddWarGoalPanel.HasSelectedWarGoalType)]"
            }
        }
    }
}

}

blockoverride "minimal_override" {
}

type minimal_widget = default_block_window {
}

# BROKEN: second operator in otherwise obvious block header.
type broken_widget = default_block_window = {
}

# BROKEN: missing block after otherwise obvious header.
type missing_widget = default_block_window

# Adjacent bare statement then valid block statement.
optimize_memory
foo_after_bare {}


# ============================================================================
# EU4 [[parameter] ... ] syntax
# ============================================================================

generate_advisor = {
    [[scaled_skill]
        $scaled_skill$
    ]

    [[!skill] if = {} ]
}

# BROKEN parameter forms for future recovery work.
broken_parameter_container = {
    [[scaled_skill
        $scaled_skill$
    ]
}

broken_parameter_container_2 = {
    [[!skill] if = {} 
}


# ============================================================================
# Additional recovery stress
# ============================================================================

recovery_container = {
    good_before = yes

    # BROKEN: repeated operator.
    bad_1 = = foo

    good_after_1 = yes

    # BROKEN: malformed block header with two operators.
    type bad_widget = default_block_window = {}

    good_after_2 = yes

    # BROKEN: operator-only statement.
    =

    good_after_3 = yes
}

# Root-level malformed material between valid statements.
root_good_1 = yes
= =
root_good_2 = yes

# Final valid statement so recovery can demonstrate forward progress.
final_statement = yes

# BROKEN: mismatched / missing closing delimiters.
[BrokenCall( Inner(foo), bar

# BROKEN: stray closing parenthesis inside opaque group.
][BrokenParen(foo))]

# BROKEN: missing closing bracket.
@broken_expression = @[1/3

# BROKEN: extra closing bracket.
@broken_expression_2 = @[1/3]]

# BROKEN: unterminated string.
broken_scalar_4 = "unterminated
